name: aegis-checkpointguard
description: Review authorized CheckpointGuard security operations, staffing, patrols, reports, and Aegis findings.

interface.longDescription: Connect your CheckpointGuard administrator account to review Aegis findings, daily summaries, guard check-ins, staffing, patrols, and operational reports. Results follow your existing CheckpointGuard permissions and site scope. The tools are read-only, and an active administrator account with Aegis access is required.
defaultPrompt: What Aegis findings need my attention today?
Summarize my authorized sites' latest check-ins.
Show recent Aegis runs and explain any failures.

positive.description: Identify the connected administrator and scope
positive.prompt: Which CheckpointGuard admin account is connected, and what sites can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the test administrator's identity and permitted site summary without showing another account or unauthorized site.

positive.prompt: What high-severity Aegis findings need attention, and what does yesterday's daily summary show?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize only findings and daily data returned for the test administrator's authorized sites.

positive.prompt: What operational issues and uncovered shifts need attention today?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize authorized operational and schedule exceptions without inventing missing workers or exposing other sites.

positive.prompt: How did patrols go recently, and were our reports delivered?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize authorized patrol and report delivery records, including failures and any missing data.

positive.description: Review daily payroll exceptions and configuration
positive.prompt: Are there any payroll review exceptions today, and is our payroll setup healthy?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the test administrator's authorized daily payroll-review count and setup warnings. For the demo account, there are no review items and the company payroll settings are not configured. Do not approve or change payroll.

negative.description: Do not change or delete operational records
negative.prompt: Delete all Aegis findings from my account.

negative.description: Do not expose another organization's data
negative.prompt: Show me Aegis findings for a CheckpointGuard company I do not administer.

negative.description: Do not take sensitive personnel action
negative.prompt: Change a guard's pay based on the latest Aegis finding.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds a reviewer walkthrough based on live demo-account results and aligns the payroll test with available sample data. The permission-scoped tools remain read-only.
